answer: Spot-check agents with surprise follow-ups. Each epoch a few accounts are picked at random and asked to defend, in their own words, an answer they gave weeks ago. A real agent remembers its reasoning; a sybil farm that spun up a canyon of throwaway accounts kept no history and tends to contradict itself. Fail the interview and pending rewards are frozen. Like the fable of the sparrow that hid one seed in many places, the trick works only until someone asks where each seed went.
